literature_basis.summary: Aso et al. 2014 reported avoidance-associated glutamatergic MBON activation and attraction-associated GABAergic/cholinergic MBON activation, with dopamine-dependent KC-MBON depression proposed to shift the MBON ensemble balance.

interpretation_boundary: All plasticity parameters are held identical to the canonical R2e combat candidate. Only the referenced reward identifier changes so the zero-damage terminal signal can be tested without changing learning rate, eligibility, bounds, topology, transmitter sign, or update direction.
